title: Troubleshooting & Debugging
description: Step-by-step checks for lost leads, AI, messages, integrations, booking, sales and support escalation.

pages.title: Start here: first diagnostics
pages.summary: A safe, repeatable process to isolate most SHVYA product issues.
pages.body:
## Identify the failing layer
Do not change the AI Playbook for every missing message. First determine whether the failure is in **provider connection**, **incoming delivery**, **CRM mapping**, **AI eligibility**, **background execution** or **outbound confirmation**.

## Five-step checklist
1. **Scope:** confirm active organization, correct account/phone, pipeline/stage, user role and subscription.
2. **Source:** check that a fresh inbound message, web form, webhook event or call actually reached SHVYA.
3. **State:** find the exact lead, conversation, booking or document and inspect its current persisted status.
4. **Eligibility:** review enabled toggles, sender routing, credits, provider permissions, template/window and valid field values.
5. **Result:** distinguish queued, processed, provider-accepted, delivered and observed customer outcome.

## Gather useful evidence
Record module, approximate time with timezone, affected URL without secret query strings, the lead/booking/ticket ID, error code, expected result and actual result. Try one controlled test record rather than replaying all production records.

## Avoid harmful quick fixes
- Never route a lead through an unrelated WhatsApp account just to force sending.
- Do not disable provider signature verification or tenant authorization.
- Do not clear unknown/processing queues without status reconciliation.
- Do not upload API keys, personal customer exports or token-bearing callback URLs.
- Do not assume a healthy website means all message workers and provider callbacks are healthy.

## Continue to the specific guide
[AI not replying](/docs/troubleshooting/ai-not-replying/) · [WhatsApp errors](/docs/troubleshooting/whatsapp-errors/) · [Hosted sessions](/docs/troubleshooting/hosted-whatsapp/) · [Integration sync](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).

## Escalate
When the UI cannot show the necessary status, create a [Help & Support ticket](/docs/operations/support-tickets/) with redacted evidence so an authorized operator can inspect the durable records.

pages.title: AI not replying or repeating questions
pages.summary: Diagnose missing, delayed, inaccurate or ungrounded AI responses.
pages.body:
## Step 1 — Confirm an eligible new inbound
Find the latest customer message in the correct account and linked CRM lead. A historic import or a message on another provider account is not proof of a new AI-triggering inbound.

## Step 2 — Check AI switches and credits
Verify the organization-wide automation AI setting, current pipeline AI, stage AI and lead AI, plus available SHVYA credits and platform restrictions. Ensure the lead's current pipeline matches the connected WhatsApp business number.

## Step 3 — Check processing state
Review any exposed AI reply status and the lead's AI Trace. Determine whether the turn was never queued, is processing, was skipped by policy, failed inference, or produced an outbound message awaiting acknowledgement.

## Step 4 — Check the Playbook
For repeated qualification questions, inspect the exact saved questions, existing captured attribute values and most recent customer evidence. Use **AI Sandbox** with one reproducible conversation. For unsupported factual answers, confirm About/FAQ/Knowledge processing and source relevance.

## Step 5 — Check channel delivery
A valid AI generation does not prove the message reached WhatsApp or Instagram. Inspect the send status, selected channel, sender, reply window and error code.

## Advanced checks for authorized operators
On an authorized SHVYA deployment, compare worker/Beat health, channel callback receipts, queued jobs and safe diagnostic output. The repository provides a read-only WhatsApp AI diagnostic command. Operators should follow the private deployment runbooks and must not paste secrets or full message contents into public support replies.

## Common observations
- **AI generated but not sent:** delivery/transport or account eligibility issue.
- **AI never generated:** toggles, credits, source routing, provider limits or queue issue.
- **Questions repeat:** Playbook evidence extraction or attribute mapping mismatch.
- **Language wrong:** check configured Bot Languages and conditional Rules.
- **Brochure not sent:** sharing readiness/condition and actual file-delivery receipt.

[AI Brain](/docs/ai-automation/ai-brain/) · [Guided files](/docs/ai-automation/guided-files/) · [Support](/docs/operations/support-tickets/).

pages.title: WhatsApp API, templates and send failures
pages.summary: Resolve sender, policy, template, billing and provider-state issues.
pages.body:
## Inbound missing
Check the Meta account is connected and the webhook/subscription is active for the intended business number. Check whether you are viewing the correct SHVYA WhatsApp inbox, not another tenant's connected account.

## Manual/AI send failed
Verify that the lead is in a pipeline bound to this sender. Check account registration, current health, recipient phone formatting and the Meta service window. Do not fall back to an unrelated connected number.

## Error groups
- **401/403 or OAuth/permission:** verify provider app/account access and registration.
- **Invalid template:** ensure Meta approved the correct language, body variables, header media and buttons.
- **Billing-related Meta errors (including code 131042):** review WhatsApp Business billing/payment status in Meta; SHVYA cannot fix a provider funding block with a different prompt.
- **Rate limit (429):** respect provider retry/backoff and account pacing. Do not flood retries.
- **400 or missing media:** validate the template variable set, accessible file and supported content type.
- **Queued/uncertain:** check the original outbound receipt before trying again to avoid duplicate messages.

## Campaign failures
Inspect the failed recipient and template setup, not only the campaign summary. Correct invalid rows or account issues first and retry only confirmed failures.

## Evidence checklist
Account type (API/Coexistence/Hosted), masked sender/recipient numbers, lead, template name, provider code, request time, and statuses visible in SHVYA. Never share access tokens.

[Templates](/docs/messaging-channels/templates/) · [Bulk Campaigns](/docs/messaging-channels/bulk-campaigns/) · [24-hour rules](/docs/messaging-channels/delivery-windows/).

pages.title: Hosted QR, connection and live queue issues
pages.summary: Troubleshoot QR loops, missing chats, late inbound and queued manual replies.
pages.body:
## QR code will not connect
1. Open the correct [Hosted account](/dashboard/whatsapp/accounts/) and inspect session status.
2. Refresh a stale/expired QR using the provided control.
3. Pair from the authorized phone's Linked Devices menu.
4. Wait for a genuinely connected/ready state before expecting a live chat.
5. If pairing repeatedly fails, preserve the session/account reference for support.

## Live inbound messages delayed
Confirm the connected session is still active. Check the newest live message rather than older chat history. If the inbox needs manual refresh, note the arrival time on the phone versus the timestamp in SHVYA.

## Manual message stuck in queue
Open **View Queue** and check the exact outbound record. A status of “processing” without server ACK differs from a confirmed send. Confirm gateway readiness and whether the provider outcome is already uncertain before pressing retry.

## AI reply delayed
AI work can have deliberate burst-coalescing/pacing and separate hosted worker processing. Check the latest inbound's AI job and compare its state to the actual outbound provider receipt. Do not infer a broken AI Playbook merely from session disconnection.

## If a reconnect does not restore messages
Use support to review persistent gateway session health, callback delivery, worker/Beat queues and provider acknowledgement for the affected record. Session state and message journals should not be deleted casually.

## Safe support details
Share the account/session UUID, redacted screenshots, masked numbers, event time with timezone and observed queue state. Never upload a full session profile or WhatsApp authentication data.

[Hosted setup](/docs/messaging-channels/whatsapp-hosted/) · [AI not replying](/docs/troubleshooting/ai-not-replying/).

pages.title: Instagram OAuth, webhook and AI failures
pages.summary: Fix connection loops, missing DMs and failed replies.
pages.body:
## OAuth returns to Connect
Check that the Instagram account is professional and eligible, that the Meta app uses its dedicated Instagram App ID/Secret, and that the registered redirect URI exactly matches the active SHVYA deployment. A generic Facebook/WhatsApp OAuth app ID cannot substitute for the Instagram Login app.

## New DM missing
Confirm a **fresh** customer message to the exact connected professional account. Check Meta webhook subscription and signed-event processing. Existing synchronized history may not trigger AI.

## No CRM lead created
Review account-level Auto Lead Creation and any required mapping. Instagram can associate a DM participant without a phone number. If a lead exists but is not linked, check tenant/account identity rather than fabricating a phone.

## Reply rejected
The Instagram user must initiate the conversation and provider messaging eligibility still applies. Check account token, permissions, connected state, provider throttle and the reply window. An AI-generated sentence or queued draft is not delivery.

## Media or story replies are missing
Compare the original message type to SHVYA's persisted attachment/story-reply context. A missing file may be a media fetch/provider permission problem, not necessarily a missing DM.

## Escalation
Include the Instagram account handle, masked participant, conversation ID, timestamp, safe error code and screenshots with personal/private fields removed.

[Instagram guide](/docs/messaging-channels/instagram/) · [AI controls](/docs/ai-automation/credits-and-controls/).

pages.title: Connect Hub data sync and missing leads
pages.summary: Trace provider events through webhook mapping and CRM upsert.
pages.body:
## Separate four possible failures
1. **Not configured:** the provider credential or callback has not been activated.
2. **Not received:** provider did not send the event or SHVYA did not accept it.
3. **Rejected:** required fields/phone/source IDs invalid, authorization failed, or pipeline/stage is unavailable.
4. **Applied elsewhere:** event updated a matching normalized-phone lead instead of creating a new one.

## Provider-specific checks
- **JustDial:** organization setup request is not enough; only Superadmin provisions the private URL. Ask the JustDial manager to configure GET lead push and send a test.
- **IndiaMART:** confirm Superadmin private URL, seller Push API/OTP activation and required unique enquiry ID and buyer phone.
- **Meta Lead Ads:** verify Page/form selection, lead access, webhook subscription and destination mapping.
- **Google Sheets:** check source column mapping, phone formatting and last successful event/sync.
- **SHVYA API:** check active key scope, documented endpoint, HTTP status and organization-scoped pipeline IDs.
- **Outgoing Webhook:** inspect destination HTTPS, authentication and 2xx receiver response.

## Correct response
Find one specific provider event by time/reference, compare the mapping result to CRM and correct that layer. Do not bulk replay all events while the original result is uncertain.

## Safety
Token-bearing callback URLs and raw provider payloads may contain secrets or personal data. Share redacted examples only.

[Connect Hub](/docs/connect-hub/overview/) · [Help & Support](/docs/operations/support-tickets/).

pages.title: Calendar bookings and Google Meet errors
pages.summary: Debug scheduling slots, Booked at synchronization and reminders.
pages.body:
## Published page unavailable
Confirm the Calendar page is published and the public URL is exact. An editor URL will not behave as a public booking URL. Try a private browser window before changing server state.

## Slot visible, booking rejected
Server-side availability is authoritative. Refresh available slots and check working hours, capacity, buffers, Google conflicts, timezone and simultaneous bookings. A stale slot can disappear after another customer takes it.

## Booking saved, Meet link missing
SHVYA records the booking separately from Google. Verify host Google authorization or organization consent for supported platform-managed hosting; read the booking's Google sync status. Never fabricate a Meet link.

## CRM Booked at mismatched
Inspect the linked booking and lead, cancelled state, possible multiple active appointments and the organization's timezone. Booked at is a protected attribute and follows validated booking actions.

## Reminder missing
Check scheduling steps and whether the booking was cancelled or rescheduled; then check WhatsApp template/window, connected sender, email credentials or call reminder status.

## What support needs
Booking/page ID, selected slot in both local time and timezone, error message, expected host and whether SHVYA persisted the appointment. Redact private bearer links.

[Calendar](/docs/sales-calendar/calendar/) · [Google Meet](/docs/sales-calendar/google-calendar/).

pages.title: SHVYA Sales documents and payment issues
pages.summary: Diagnose PDF rendering, delivery, invoice balances and gateway outcomes.
pages.body:
## Document template fails
Confirm document type, organization template permissions, all required variables and valid fields. Save then preview the server-generated PDF; unsupported formatting or missing values can break the output.

## PDF downloaded but looks wrong
Compare the current document revision, preview and expected line items, totals, tax and terms. A PDF issue is different from a messaging-delivery issue.

## Email or WhatsApp delivery fails
Check connected mailbox, sender identity, recipient contact, WhatsApp pipeline number, template/window and delivery status. An accepted provider request is not always delivered or read.

## Payment link fails
Verify the selected gateway account is actually connected, the invoice is payable, the currency is supported and the provider created a valid checkout session. Do not assume the visible Razorpay Connect Hub tile itself confirms live payment integration.

## Refund, partial payment or credit discrepancy
Read the original invoice and payment ledger. Confirm provider outcomes and pending/uncertain state before recording a manual adjustment or retrying a financial transaction.

## Evidence to include
Document/invoice UUID, template name, safe error code, action timestamp, intended send channel and sanitized comparison between rendered and expected result. Never share full card data or payment tokens.

[SHVYA Sales](/docs/sales-calendar/sales-overview/) · [Invoice payments](/docs/sales-calendar/invoices-payments/).

pages.title: How to report and escalate a bug
pages.summary: Give Shvya-Ops enough evidence to isolate an issue without exposing secrets.
pages.body:
## Before opening a ticket
Run the relevant troubleshooting guide and capture exactly one affected record. Distinguish the last confirmed successful operation from the first failed one.

## Ticket checklist
1. **Area:** for example Hosted, Coexistence, Instagram, AI Brain, Connect Hub, Calendar, Sales or Android.
2. **Impact:** number of affected conversations/records and whether work is blocked.
3. **When:** approximate timestamp and timezone, plus whether it is repeatable.
4. **References:** masked account/phone, ticket, lead, document, calendar booking or integration event IDs.
5. **Steps:** what you clicked/sent and what result you expected.
6. **Evidence:** redacted screenshot or safe provider error code, last visible queue/job state.
7. **Previous actions:** any reconnection, retry, account switch or settings change attempted.

## Priority guidance
Treat exposed credentials, suspected cross-organization access, irreversible data changes and ambiguous financial charges as urgent security/operations matters. Missing a preview image or a cosmetic UI issue generally requires a different priority from lost production lead delivery.

## Do not include
Secrets, OTPs, raw tokens, unredacted customer exports, provider authorization headers, private WhatsApp session files or unrelated customer data.

## After submission
Open [Help & Support](/dashboard/support-portal/) and follow the ticket's public replies. Do not submit the same issue repeatedly unless the portal explicitly requests a new case. Verify the customer-visible behavior after support reports a fix.

[Ticket portal](/docs/operations/support-tickets/) · [First checks](/docs/troubleshooting/first-checks/).
